'''Vines''' were a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. Types of vines included [[borscii vine]]s,<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> [[thorn-vine]]s,<ref name="Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> and [[Misura vine]]s.<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>
